meta.name: tfx-plan
meta.description: 구현 계획이 필요할 때 사용한다. '계획 세워줘', 'plan', '플랜', '어떻게 구현하지', '태스크 분해', '작업 순서', '합의 계획', 'ralplan', '철저한 계획' 같은 요청에 반드시 사용.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成实现计划与任务顺序
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对复杂实现任务却不知如何拆分步骤
copy.tagline_en: Turn your implementation idea into an ordered task plan.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you face a complex task and need to break it into steps.

howto.what: 装上后,当你说要制定实施计划,Claude 会调用多个 AI 模型分头设计、交叉审查、打分,最后给出一份含设计、任务、风险、测试等内容的计划书。加 --quick 则出精简版。
howto.when: 当你说出“制定计划”、“plan”、“任务分解”等请求时触发;带 --quick 参数则改为快速模式。

say.text: 帮我制定一个 JWT 认证中间件的实施计划。
say.note: 走默认深度模式,多模型共识计划。

say.text: 把微服务拆分的实施计划做一下。
say.note: 多轮设计后会输出共识计划。

say.text: 用快速模式规划给 README 添加章节。
say.note: 走 Quick 模式,快速输出精简计划。

howto.what_en: When installed, when you ask for an implementation plan, Claude calls multiple AI models to design separately, cross-review, and score, then outputs a plan covering design, tasks, risks, tests, etc. With --quick it gives a concise version.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say things like 'make a plan', 'plan', 'task breakdown' that require an implementation plan; with --quick it uses quick mode.

say_en.text: Help me create an implementation plan for adding JWT authentication middleware.
say_en.note: Uses default deep mode with multi-model consensus.

say_en.text: Make an implementation plan for splitting the microservices.
say_en.note: Outputs a consensus plan after multiple rounds.

say_en.text: Use quick mode to plan adding a README section.
say_en.note: Runs Quick mode for a concise plan.
